billing.faq49Q1: Pehea e hana ai ka hoʻāʻo manuahi 7 lā?
billing.faq49A1: Ma ka checkout pono ʻoe e hōʻoia i kahi kāleka panakō ma o Stripe — pono ia, akā ʻaʻohe mea i uku ʻia no 7 mau lā a loaʻa iā ʻoe ke komo piha. Ke pau ka hoʻāʻo, e uku ʻia ʻo €49/mahina maʻalahi. Hoʻopau ma mua o ka pau ʻana o nā lā 7 a ʻaʻole ʻoe e uku ʻia.
billing.faq49Q2: He aha ka mea i uku ʻia no ka €49/mahina?
billing.faq49A2: ʻO ka pūpū autopilot: ka huli ʻana i nā ʻano a me nā analytics, ka hoʻopaʻa ʻana i ka lehulehu, ka UGC studio, ka Chrome extension, ka Publisher me kahi hoʻolālā ʻike, ka autopilot a me ka Gallery. ʻAʻole i hoʻokomo ʻia ka hana AI ponoʻī — holo ia ma o kāu mau kau inoa (Google Flow, NotebookLM, HeyGen) a i ʻole kāu mau kī API, a uku pololei ʻoe i nā mea hāʻawi ma kā lākou mau kumukūʻai.
billing.faq49Q3: No ke aha i ʻoi aku ka liʻiliʻi o nā kau inoa ma mua o ka API?
billing.faq49A3: Kūʻai nā mea hāʻawi i nā hōʻaiʻē kau inoa ʻoi aku ka liʻiliʻi ma mua o nā kekona like ma o API: ʻo Veo ma kahi kau inoa Google AI he 2–10× ʻoi aku ka liʻiliʻi, ʻo HeyGen avatars ma kahi o 3× ʻoi aku ka liʻiliʻi. A ʻaʻohe API lehulehu ʻo NotebookLM — kau inoa wale nō. Hoʻopau ka extension i ka hana i loko o kāu mau moʻokāki ponoʻī, e hāʻawi ana iā ʻoe i ka maʻalahi like me API ma nā kumukūʻai kau inoa. Aia nā helu pololei i ka papaʻaina a me ka helu helu ma luna.
billing.faq49Q4: He aha nā kau inoa e pono ai iaʻu?
billing.faq49A4: Ua lawa ʻelua e hoʻomaka ai: Google AI Pro (€21.99/mahina — Flow wikiō + NotebookLM me nā palena kiʻekiʻe) a me HeyGen Creator ($29/mahina — ma kahi o 30 mau minuke o Avatar IV). Loaʻa i kēlā me kēia lawelawe nā palena manuahi (Flow — 50 credits/lā, NotebookLM — 3 overviews/lā, HeyGen — 3 wikiō/mahina), no laila hiki iā ʻoe ke hoʻāʻo i ka pipeline me ka ʻole o nā kau inoa.
billing.faq49Q5: Hiki iaʻu ke hana me nā kī API wale nō?
billing.faq49A5: ʻAe. Hoʻohui i kāu mau kī (Google Veo, FAL/Kling, Runway, OpenAI, ElevenLabs, HeyGen, Claude) ma nā Settings a hana pololei ka lawelawe me lākou, ʻaʻohe extension e pono ai. Uku ʻoe i kēlā mau lawelawe ma kā lākou mau kumukūʻai. Hoʻohui manuahi nā ala: nā avatars ma ke kau inoa, voice-over ma o API, no ka laʻana.
billing.faq49Q6: Pehea wau e hoʻopau ai? Aia i hea ke pihi?
billing.faq49A6: Ma ka piko o kēia ʻaoʻao, ma ka pepa “Kou hoʻolālā,” e ʻike ʻia ke pihi “Hoʻopau i ka hoʻoulu hou ʻana” i ka wā e hana ana ke kau inoa. ʻAʻole e hoʻihoʻi ʻia nā manawa uku, akā mau ke komo a hiki i ka pau ʻana o ka manawa. E hoʻopau i ka wā hoʻāʻo a ʻaʻole ʻoe e uku ʻia. Hiki iā ʻoe ke hoʻomaka hou me hoʻokahi kaomi i kēlā me kēia manawa ma mua o ka pau ʻana o ka manawa.
billing.faq49A7: ʻAe. E hoʻokomo i kahi code hoʻolaha ma luna – e hoʻohana ʻia ka uku ma ka Premium checkout ma o Stripe.
billing.disclaimer49: ʻAʻole pili ʻo TrendTraffic me Google, HeyGen, ElevenLabs a i ʻole Blotato. Ua ʻōlelo ʻia nā kumukūʻai o nā mea hāʻawi mai nā papa kumukūʻai kūhelu mai Iulai 2026 a hiki ke loli.
